flag_meanings.OT_NOT_ITEMISED: overtime was played but the site does not list all of its periods; quarters are complete and overtime points are final minus regulation
flag_meanings.PERIOD_SUM_MISMATCH: quarters plus overtime do not add up to the final score
flag_meanings.LIST_SCORE_MISMATCH: the match report's final differs from the daily list's final
flag_meanings.OT_WITHOUT_TIE: overtime is listed but regulation was not tied
flag_meanings.TIED_FINAL: final score is level (possible in two-leg ties; otherwise suspect)
flag_meanings.SUSPECT_VALUE: an unusual score: a quarter above 60, a 0-0 quarter, or a final under 20
flag_meanings.BAD_VALUE: a score is missing or not a whole number
